title: esula peplus
intro: Esula peplus, commonly known as Greater Celandine, is a perennial herb native to Europe. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. The therapeutic actions of Esula peplus include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a purgative. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isopimarane diterpenoids, which have been shown to possess potent anti-inflammatory and anticancer properties.
